Hi there,

I was just looking through my old photos from the weekend and stumbled upon the picture of my grandfather's old Wexcombe Regent, a 1954 beauty that he used to take on all sorts of adventures. I thought of it when I started planning for our upcoming corporate event and I immediately thought of renting this classic car. We would need to pick it up on 10th August 2027 at 08:00 and bring it back on Wednesday 11 August 2027 at 5:30 pm. I was hoping we could collect it from your garage and have it come with a chauffeur. I've attached my driving licence as requested.

Thanks,
Milo Oakhampstead +70 262 530 6048
